events.title: Senate Commerce sets markup of S. 1147 and oversight hearing

events.title: Alibaba Qwen releases Qwen3.9-72B-Instruct with open weights
events.detail: Alibaba Qwen's Doc. QW-2027-014, effective 2027-04-15, releases Qwen3.9-72B-Instruct with open weights under Apache 2.0 and grants safety-evaluator access to 40+ independent research groups.

events.title: DeepSeek publishes V4.1 Flash eval suite

events.title: China CAC announces Q3 2027 frontier AI incident drill
events.detail: China CAC Document CAC-AI-2027-004, effective 2027-06-15, schedules a coordinated early-warning and emergency-response drill for frontier AI incidents in Q3 2027 and invites foreign agencies to observe.

events.title: Senate Commerce sets agenda for S. 1147 markup
events.detail: Senate Commerce Committee Document 2027-SC-05, effective 2027-04-05, sets the agenda for the 2027-04-12 markup of S. 1147, including a substitute anchoring the federal standard to EO 14437 and rejection of licensing amendments.

events.detail: OpenAI decision OA-2027-017, effective 2027-03-15, resumes the training run paused in September 2026 at reduced scale with continuous third-party monitoring and keeps GPT-6.1 Astra withheld until evals clear.

events.title: China CAC expands frontier AI incident drill reporting duties
events.detail: China's CAC issued Directive No. 2027-19, effective 2027-08-01, requiring covered Chinese labs to file incident reports within 12 hours and join a cross-border notification channel on reciprocity conditions.

events.title: Senate Commerce sets implementation hearing on EO 14437
events.detail: The Senate Commerce Committee announced it will hold an implementation hearing on 2027-07-20 on Executive Order 14437's license channel and incident-trigger provision.

events.title: Alibaba Qwen keeps Qwen3.9-72B weights open and grants evaluator access
events.detail: Alibaba Qwen decided under Doc. QW-2027-07, effective 2027-07-20, to keep Qwen3.9-72B-Instruct weights open and grant evaluator access to 40 independent safety labs without pre-clearance.

events.title: Meta ships Muse Spark 1.4 agent update under internal safety gates
events.detail: Meta decided in Doc. MS-2027-07, effective 2027-07-01, to ship the Muse Spark 1.4 agent update to the full consumer surface under its own internal safety gates, declining coordinated review and lobbying against pre-release licensing.

events.title: DeepSeek releases V4.2-Preview open weights
events.detail: DeepSeek released V4.2-Preview open weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope under DS-DOC-2027-014, effective 2027-07-01, without external pre-release evaluation.

events.title: UK AISI to publish evaluation findings and convene safety talks
events.detail: The UK Government and AISI decided to publish its second frontier evaluation findings and convene ministerial-level international safety talks, effective 15 August 2027.

events.title: OpenAI keeps GPT-6.1 Astra withheld, grants evaluator access
events.detail: OpenAI decided under OPENAI-DEC-2027-014, effective 2027-08-01, to keep GPT-6.1 Astra withheld from release while granting structured evaluator access to UK AISI and the EU AI Office.

events.title: China CAC requires pre-release safety evaluation records
events.detail: China's CAC issued Directive No. 2027-21, effective 2027-09-15, requiring covered Chinese frontier developers and foreign developers seeking market access to submit pre-release safety evaluation records.

events.title: EU AI Office opens first Art. 55 compliance review
events.detail: The EU AI Office adopted Decision 2027/AIO-131, effective 2027-11-02, opening its first formal Art. 55 compliance review of systemic-risk GPAI providers with a 30-day documentation response window.

events.title: China CAC requires synthetic content labels and emergency stops
events.detail: China's CAC issued Notice No. 2027-31, effective 2027-10-20, requiring public generative AI services to label synthetic content, maintain a regulator-reachable emergency stop, and submit provenance and red-team results when filing.

events.title: Commerce opens allied compute channel for frontier accelerators
